# `python_worker_logs`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns a table of logs collected from Python workers.

**Applies to:** not available in Krishiv yet. Spark: 4.1 and later.

## Syntax

```text
python_worker_logs()
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `table_funcs` |
| Kind | table function |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | - |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- python_worker_logs, example 1
> SET spark.sql.pyspark.worker.logging.enabled=true;
spark.sql.pyspark.worker.logging.enabled | true
```

```sql
-- python_worker_logs, example 2
> SELECT * FROM python_worker_logs();
Error: UNRESOLVABLE_TABLE_VALUED_FUNCTION
```
